import json,urllib.request,urllib.error
root="https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/console/"
def get(url,method="GET",body=None):
    req=urllib.request.Request(root+url,data=body,method=method,headers={"User-Agent":"OnTrack-Voice-Console-Smoke/1.0","Content-Type":"application/json","Cache-Control":"no-cache"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as r:
            return r.status,r.read(40000).decode(errors="replace")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code,e.read(40000).decode(errors="replace")
home,b=get("")
assert home==200,("home",home,b[:80])
status,b=get("device/v1/index.php")
assert status==405 and json.loads(b).get("error")=="method_not_allowed",("device_get",status,b[:100])
status,b=get("device/v1/index.php","POST",b'{"operation":"published_flow"}')
assert status==401 and json.loads(b).get("error")=="authorization_required",("device_auth",status,b[:100])
status,js=get("assets/js/flow-graph.js")
assert status==200 and len(js)>1000,("flow_js",status,len(js))
status,app=get("assets/js/app.js")
assert status==200 and len(app)>1000,("app_js",status,len(app))
